OCCUPANCY_EPISODE by itself does not supply those fields; old/new identity lineage cannot be silently reinterpreted as occupancy.
gaps.evidence: reviewed-input/canonical/inventory.json V06-occupancy explicitly calls for row-specific occupancy evidence in addition to the lifecycle token; the independent interface review confirms that the token alone is insufficient.

additionalInspectedContracts.limit: Only lot lineage endpoints and evaluation time; no typed occupied container/place and occupancy interval.
Artifact metadata can bind retained report bytes, but contains no occupancy endpoint or interval content; createdAt is not occupancy time.
The exact implementation source explicitly defers payload contracts for Site, ManagementZone, MicroclimateZone, Lot, Facility, StorageLocation and Container.

gaps.rowOwnedSelectionProfileAssessment: A row-owned profile may select and compare exact occupancy fields from an already existing named source format, with its schema, immutable bytes and endpoint/time semantics selected independently. No such typed format is supplied by the inspected lifecycle, lot-lineage or LocalArtifact records. A profile cannot turn old/new identity arrays into occupied-by relations, treat createdAt/evaluatedAt as occupancy start/end, or assert a new foreign record schema. Raw external report bytes could be supported after the exact existing source format is identified; absent production records alone are not a blocker.
